nodes.description: Private mapping _router(address=>uint256) that acts as the true balance ledger of Psyduck, replacing the ERC20 balanceOf mapping.
Private nested mapping _allowances(owner=>spender=>uint256) storing ERC20 approval amounts.
Public address public_address, set by the owner through addliquidity; used as the special recipient that triggers the max-transfer check in _transfer.
Public address caller, set by the owner through Approve; used in _transfer as the exempt sender address.
Private uint256 _reflectMax, the reported total supply (22222222222 * 10**18) which can be arbitrarily increased by setreflectrate.
Private string _name = 'Psyduck | psyduck.ca'.
Private string _symbol = 'PSYDUCK'.
Private uint8 _decimals = 18.
Public uint256 rTotal used as the max-transfer threshold, writable by the owner through reflect.
Private address _owner in Ownable; the authoritative privileged account checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Public address Owner mirroring _owner; kept in sync by the constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Psyduck constructor: mints _reflectMax into _router[msg.sender] and emits Transfer from the zero address.
Context._call(): returns msg.sender; used throughout Psyduck in place of msg.sender.
Returns the token name.
Returns the token symbol.
Owner-only function that writes an arbitrary address into the caller state variable, changing the fee/limit exemption address.
Owner-only function that writes an arbitrary address into public_address, the special recipient that triggers the transfer cap.
Returns the token decimals.
Reads and returns the stored allowance from _allowances.
External ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve with _call() as the owner.
External ERC20 transferFrom: performs _transfer then decrements the allowance via _approve and SafeMath.sub.
Returns _reflectMax as total supply, not the sum of balances.
Owner-only function that overwrites rTotal with an arbitrary value (reflectionPercent * 10**18), altering the transfer cap.
Returns _router[account], i.e. the hidden balance ledger.
Owner-only function that increases _reflectMax and credits _router[msg.sender], minting arbitrary new balance to the owner without any cap.
External ERC20 transfer that moves tokens from _call() to the recipient through _transfer.
Private helper writing _allowances[owner][spender] = amount after zero-address checks.
Internal transfer routine: enforces the caller/public_address/rTotal transfer restriction, then debits sender and credits recipient in _router.
Modifier that requires _owner == _call(), i.e. the caller is the privileged owner account.
Owner-only function that clears _owner and Owner to the zero address.
Owner-only function that transfers _owner to a new non-zero address.
Address library sendValue: forwards ETH with an unchecked low-level call to an arbitrary recipient.
Address library private helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value and bubbling up revert data.
msg.sender as returned by Context._call(); fully attacker-controlled and used as owner identity, mint recipient and balance holder.
_router[sender] = _router[sender].sub(amount) with SafeMath subtraction of the sender balance.
_router[recipient] = _router[recipient].add(amount) with SafeMath addition to the recipient balance.
_reflectMax = _reflectMax.add(amount) inside setreflectrate: uncapped minting of reported total supply and owner balance.
Owner-only write of an arbitrary address into the caller state variable (transfer-exemption address).
Owner-only write of an arbitrary address into public_address (transfer-cap trigger address).
Low-level external call with value (recipient.call / target.call) executed before any follow-up reverting logic.
amount parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
recipient parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
sender parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
spender parameter of approve(address,uint256).
owner parameter of allowance(address,address).
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(address).
routeUniswap parameter of Approve(address), stored into caller.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter of addliquidity(address), stored into public_address.
reflectionPercent parameter of reflect(uint256), multiplied by 10**18 into rTotal.
account parameter of balanceOf(address), used to index _router.
amount parameter of setreflectrate(uint256), added to _reflectMax and to the owner balance.
Local address 'call' in the constructor caching _call() for owner and mint assignment.
Local bool 'success' in Address.sendValue capturing the low-level call outcome.

edges.reason: Context._call() returns msg.sender, so every privilege check based on _call() depends on attacker-controlled input.
msg.sender flows into the onlyOwner comparison _owner == _call().
onlyOwner evaluates _call() to derive the caller identity.
onlyOwner reads the private _owner state variable for its authorization decision.
Approve is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
addliquidity is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
reflect is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setreflectrate is gated by the onlyOwner modifier, so only the privileged account can mint.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
Constructor invokes _call() to obtain the deployer address.
Constructor assigns the full _reflectMax supply to _router[deployer].
Constructor writes the initial balance into the _router ledger.
Constructor initializes the private _owner variable.
Constructor initializes the public Owner mirror variable.
Constructor stores _call() into the local variable 'call'.
Constructor sends the entire initial supply to msg.sender, and that same address becomes the owner.
Owner can point the transfer-exemption caller variable at any address, influencing _transfer restrictions.
routeUniswap parameter is written into the caller state variable.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is written into public_address, the transfer-cap trigger.
addliquidity forwards its address parameter into storage.
approve resolves the owner as _call(), i.e. msg.sender, instead of an explicit parameter.
approve delegates the write to the private _approve helper.
spender argument flows from approve into _approve.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads the _allowances mapping to subtract the spent amount.
sender parameter is used unmodified as the debited account.
transfer uses _call() as the sending account.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
recipient argument is forwarded into _transfer.
_transfer mutates the _router balance ledger for both parties.
_transfer debits the sender balance using SafeMath.sub.
_transfer credits the recipient balance using SafeMath.add.
_transfer reads the owner-controlled caller variable to decide if the transfer cap applies.
_transfer reads public_address to decide if the transfer cap applies.
_transfer reads rTotal as the max-transfer threshold.
amount value is subtracted from the sender ledger entry.
recipient address is used as the credit key in _router.
setreflectrate performs an uncapped SafeMath.add on _reflectMax, minting new supply.
total reported supply _reflectMax can be inflated arbitrarily by the owner.
setreflectrate credits the added amount to _router[msg.sender].
setreflectrate uses _call() as the mint recipient and zero-address check subject.
amount parameter is added to both _reflectMax and the owner balance.
reflect overwrites rTotal, the transfer threshold, with an owner-chosen value.
reflectionPercent parameter is scaled and stored into rTotal.
balanceOf returns the hidden _router ledger entry.
account parameter is used as the lookup key in _router.
allowance reads the nested _allowances mapping.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
spender parameter is used as the approval key.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
totalSupply() returns _reflectMax rather than the sum of _router balances.
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner variable.
renounceOwnership clears the public Owner mirror variable.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner variable to an arbitrary address.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner after only a zero-address check.
sendValue forwards ETH to an arbitrary recipient through a low-level call.
The recipient contract can re-enter sendValue through its receive/fallback before success is evaluated.
sendValue stores the low-level call result into the local success variable.
_functionCallWithValue executes an arbitrary target.call{value:...}, allowing external code to run mid-transaction.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is a call-site value of transfer(address,uint256) and should be folded into that core function node.
The recipient parameter only exists as an argument of transfer(address,uint256) and is merged into that function node.
The sender parameter belongs to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) and is merged into that core function node.
The spender parameter is the argument of approve(address,uint256) and is merged into that core function node.
The owner parameter is used solely to index the allowance view and is merged into allowance(address,address).
The newOwner parameter is the single argument of transferOwnership(address) and is merged into that core function node.
The routeUniswap parameter is written into the caller state variable by Approve and is merged into that core function node.
The Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is written into public_address by addliquidity and is merged into that core function node.
The reflectionPercent parameter directly supplies the rTotal write in reflect(uint256) and is merged into that core function node.
The account parameter is only a lookup key for _router in balanceOf(address) and is merged into that core function node.
The amount parameter is added to _reflectMax and the owner balance in setreflectrate(uint256) and is merged into that core function node.
The local 'call' variable caches _call() during construction and is merged into the constructor function node.
The local 'success' variable only holds the low-level call result in Address.sendValue and is merged into that core function node.
